title: Empathy Is Not the Scapegoat for Declines in Factuality and Reliability
abstract: arXiv:2610.18541v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Language models are increasingly expected to support users in stressful or uncertain situations, where warmth and empathy are desirable. While recent work associates warmer models with reduced reliability, we show that this conclusion is incomplete. Prior studies often train primarily on empathetic dialogue, making it difficult to separate tone effects from SFT-induced distribution shift. We revisit this issue at both the model and evaluation levels. We study prompting, SFT, and RL for inducing warm behavior, and comprehensively evaluate capability preservation using an 11-dataset benchmark suite and EMOFACT under emotional contexts. Across multiple model families, we find that warmth effects are task- and model-dependent, while task-aligned adaptive tone can improve empathy and targeted reliability, although some capability trade-offs remain. translated_title: 共情不是事实性与可靠性下降的替罪羊
translated_abstract: 语言模型越来越被期望在用户处于压力或不确定情境时提供支持，此时温暖与共情是人们所期待的。虽然近期研究将更温暖的模型与可靠性下降联系起来，但我们表明这一结论并不完整。以往研究通常主要在共情对话上进行训练，导致难以将语气效应与SFT引起的分布偏移区分开来。我们在模型层面和评估层面重新审视了这一问题。我们研究了通过提示、SFT和RL来诱导温暖行为，并使用包含11个数据集的基准测试套件以及情感情境下的EMOFACT来全面评估能力保持情况。在多个模型家族上的实验表明，温暖效应因任务和模型而异，而任务对齐的自适应语气可以提升共情能力和针对性的可靠性，尽管仍存在一些能力上的权衡。我们进一步引入了经过人工验证的共情评估器，专门用于评估模型的共情表现。
tldr: 本研究证明共情并非模型事实性与可靠性下降的根源——温暖效应因任务和模型而异，通过任务对齐的自适应语气可以在提升共情的同时保持甚至提高针对性可靠性，并提出了经过人工验证的共情评估器。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates that empathy is not the culprit behind declines in factuality and reliability—warmth effects are task- and model-dependent, and task-aligned adaptive tone can improve empathy and targeted reliability, with human-validated empathy evaluators introduced for assessment.
